top_signals.title: Latin America Leads Gains in Emerging-Market FX Ahead of US CPI
top_signals.summary: Latin American currencies gained on Tuesday, pushing an index of developing-world FX to erase losses seen earlier amid higher oil prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Millennium Nears $100 Billion in New Era for Giant Hedge Funds
top_signals.summary:
Millennium Management's assets have hit $97 billion, more than double what the firm oversaw six years ago, and is speeding toward $100 billion.
The firm's founder, Izzy Englander, is ramping up an unusual model of seeding dozens of smaller would-be rivals to give his firm more capacity to take on investor cash, with $22 billion of new commitments set to close on Oct. 1. Bloomberg's Hema Parmar joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs worth CA$27.6 billion take effect as trade rift with U.S. deepens
top_signals.summary: Duties on U.S. steel and aluminum products have doubled to 50% as a war of words between Washington and Ottawa continues.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: CVC Marathon's Richards Says Equities Can Absorb 25 Bps Fed Hike (Correct)
top_signals.summary: Markets can withstand a 25 basis-point interest-rate increase by the Federal Reserve, according to Bruce Richards, managing partner and head of CVC Marathon. "The consumer is doing well, corporate earnings are doing well,  the economy is doing well," Richards says on Bloomberg Television. (Corrects guest's company name and title.) (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
